g.text: Decoder core cut: syndrome_q + overall_mismatch_q + received_q → classification → correction mask → XOR/data extraction → data_q.

text.style: font: 9px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Core registers have no reset. Shell reset is synchronous active-low; valid travels with results. Encoder and decoder are independent channels.
